background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Wells Fargo is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them now at A-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026. Capital is the weak spot, with CET1 of 10.3% in the bottom quarter of US banks, while leverage of 5.8% and LCR of 119% sit at about the median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.9 points, with LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The upgrade is the substantive news; the newest flagged item, on 1 Oct 2026, concerns the bank's research on other companies rather than the bank itself.
